name: MLflow CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Run actions/checkout@v3
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python 3.12.7
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.7'

      - name: Check Env
        run: |
          python --version
          pip --version

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install mlflow==2.19.0 pandas numpy scikit-learn

      - name: Clean old mlruns
        run: |
          rm -rf MLProject/mlruns

      - name: Run mlflow project
        run: |
          cd MLProject
          mlflow run . --env-manager=local

      - name: Get latest MLflow run_id
        run: |
          cd MLProject
          RUN_ID=$(ls -t mlruns/0 | grep -v meta.yaml | grep -v datasets | head -n 1)
          echo "RUN_ID=$RUN_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip

      - name: Upload to GitHub
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add MLProject/mlruns
          git commit -m "ci: save mlflow artifacts from run ${{ env.RUN_ID }}" || echo "no changes to commit"
          git push origin main

      - name: Build Docker Model
        run: |
          cd MLProject
          mlflow models build-docker --model-uri "runs:/${{ env.RUN_ID }}/model" --name student-performance-model --env-manager local

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Tag Docker Image
        run: |
          docker tag student-performance-model ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/student-performance-model:latest

      - name: Push Docker Image
        run: |
          docker push ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/student-performance-model:latest

import sys
import pandas as pd
import mlflow
import mlflow.sklearn
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# ambil parameter data_path jika ada
data_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "student_performance_preprocessing"

# load data hasil preprocessing
train_df = pd.read_csv(f'{data_path}/train.csv')
test_df = pd.read_csv(f'{data_path}/test.csv')

X_train = train_df.drop(columns=['GradeClass'])
y_train = train_df['GradeClass']
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=['GradeClass'])
y_test = test_df['GradeClass']

# enable autolog
mlflow.sklearn.autolog()

with mlflow.start_run(run_name="random_forest_ci"):
    model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)

    print(f"akurasi model: {acc:.4f}")

print("training selesai!")
